evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model email assistants are particularly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because untrusted email content can be retrieved into the model context and influence subsequent tool use.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five binary benchmarks, our framework achieves a mean F1 score of 0.406 under the strict threshold setting policy, compared with 0.216 for the strongest of five pretrained detectors evaluated without additional training.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Results show that random train test splits substantially overestimate robustness under distribution shift, while later tool argument stages are more predictable than earlier stages in the framework.
